decisions.reason: Flagship expansion close to core services keeps option value high under unresolved offshore-market uncertainty and low carrying cost.
Building on established offerings gives low-cost option value while demand uncertainty remains unresolved and the firm has few alternative options.
Digital portal is a strategic flagship with unresolved market potential and low marginal cost to keep as a real option.
Mobile app leverages existing capabilities and its uncertain uptake still justifies retaining the low-cost option.
